visual.name: timelineSwimlane
visual.description: Transformation portfolio timeline with swimlanes, milestones, tasks, RAG status and dependency relationships

en-US.Landing_Line1: Required: add Name and Start Date to begin.
en-US.Landing_Line2: Finish Date creates task bars; matching dates create milestones.
en-US.Landing_Line3: Optional: Swimlane, Unique ID and Predecessors add structure.
en-US.Landing_Line4: Add progress, baselines, status and links when available.
en-US.License_BrandingFeatureBlocked: A Transformation Timeline Pro licence is required to display a custom logo.
en-US.Data_Truncated: The visual reached the available row limit.
en-US.Navigation_ResetAria: Reset timeline view to saved viewport or fit
en-US.Navigation_VerticalRegionScrollable: Scrollable timeline swimlanes. Use the vertical scrollbar, mouse wheel, or keyboard to reach additional swimlanes.
en-US.Validation_ToggleSummary: Show or hide schedule validation details
en-US.Warning_DataIncompleteDetail: Power BI could not provide additional rows or the 30,000-row data-view limit was reached. Filter the schedule or reduce dependency rows to verify that all items are displayed.
en-US.Tooltip_LinkAvailable: Select this item, then use the persistent Open item button
en-US.Error_RenderDetail: Check the mapped fields and schedule values, then try again.

dataRoles.name: StartDate
dataRoles.description: Start date — also used as the position for milestones

dataRoles.name: FinishDate
dataRoles.description: Finish date (same as Start Date for milestones)

dataRoles.name: Project
dataRoles.description: Groups items into horizontal swimlane rows

dataRoles.name: UniqueID
dataRoles.description: Stable item identifier required for dependencies

dataRoles.name: DependencyCritical
dataRoles.description: One Yes/No value applies to every predecessor. For mixed criticality, provide aligned values such as Yes, No, Yes.

dataRoles.name: Colour
dataRoles.description: Category, RAG value, or explicit #RRGGBB colour. Hex values override conditional formatting; other values use the RAG/category palette.

dataRoles.name: MilestoneLevel
dataRoles.description: Activity Level 1, 2, or 3 (or High, Medium, Low) for custom task bar heights and milestone sizes.

dataRoles.name: Tooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional additional text shown in hover tooltip

dataRoles.name: ItemUrl
dataRoles.description: Absolute HTTPS link opened only after an explicit user action.

dataRoles.name: SwimlaneOrder
dataRoles.description: Numeric swimlane priority. Item Order is used when blank.
